prompt.project_info: Ultra-realistic male editorial portrait at an urban rooftop lounge at night.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult Asian man in his forties with short slightly tousled black hair greying at the temples, natural skin texture and calm contemplative expression, wearing a deep navy tailored suit over a black open-collar shirt with a vintage stainless-steel watch, cufflinks, and discreet ring.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical close-up 3:4 composition, slightly off-center at a marble bar counter, chin resting lightly on one hand and gazing into the distance; city lights, skyscraper silhouettes, bokeh, candle, and reflections in the background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Crisp camera flash on face with warm votive-candle highlights, polished cinematic warmth, modern urban luxury night atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic editorial digital photography, ultra-realistic high detail, vertical 3:4, controlled bokeh, natural skin grain, polished warm color grading.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 3:4 photorealistic editorial portrait of one generic approved Asian adult man in his forties wearing a deep navy suit and black open-collar shirt, seated at a marble rooftop-lounge bar with chin resting on one hand, contemplative gaze, crisp flash on face, warm candle accent, city lights and bokeh behind him, polished urban luxury.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized styling, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed watch or glass, watermark, logo overlay, harsh artifacts
